kv6.10:1.3: rūpaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ rūpadhātu nīlaṃ pītakaṃ lohitakaṃ odātakaṃ cakkhuviññeyyaṃ cakkhusmiṃ paṭihaññati cakkhussa āpāthaṃ āgacchatī’ti.
kv6.10:3.9: hañci ‘cakkhuviñca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇa’nti
kv6.10:3.10: atthe’va suttanto, no ca vata re vattabbe
kv6.10:4.4: nanu passati. abhikkamantaṃ paṭikkamantaṃ ālokentaṃ vilokentaṃ sammiñjentaṃ pasārenta’nti.
kv6.10:4.6: hañci passati abhikkamantaṃ paṭikkamantaṃ ālokentaṃ vilokentaṃ sammiñjentaṃ pasārentaṃ, tena vata re vattabbe’
kv6.10:4.7: kāyakammaṃ sanidassana’nti. paṭhavīdhātu sanidassanāti ādiṃ katvā
kv6.10:5.1: niyāmo asaṅkhato paṭiccasamuppādo asaṅkhato, cattāri saccāni asaṅkhatāni, cattāro āruppā asaṅkhatā, nirodhasamāpatti asaṅkhatā, ākāso asaṅkhato, ākāso sanidassano, cattāro mahābhūtā, pañcindriyāni, tatheva kāyakammanti. sattamo vaggo.
